baseline.rule: same lookback + R2 + switch_buffer + entry_fraction with momentum decay disabled

data_snapshot.pool_rule: QQQ/EWG/EWJ/GLD from 2007 start; CN_CYB_399006 joins from own data with no backfill

execution_assumptions.signal: close-to-close weighted-slope ranking with fixed R2 threshold, switch buffer, and staged entry
execution_assumptions.momentum_decay: current target holding score divided by active trade score peak; close signal sets next-session scale
execution_assumptions.recovery: ratio must recover to threshold; same trade needs a new score peak before another decay cycle
execution_assumptions.target_vol: disabled because Layer 5 rejected target-vol for this branch
execution_assumptions.mixed_market_calendar: diagnostic A-share calendar with US proxy forward-filled; base trades on stale trade legs blocked
